## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The approval comparison should be fixed because it rejects releases that exactly meet the configured minimum. This review read the existing tests without running them.

## Changes
The pull request regenerates the deployment catalog with production service names and ports, simplifies the health predicate, and changes the release approval comparison.

## Important
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Accept releases at the minimum approval count — For approvals=2 and minimum=2, approved() now returns False, contradicting the “at least” contract at zzz-release/gate.py:1. The strict comparison excludes equality; existing tests exercise only counts above and below the threshold. — Releases meeting the configured minimum remain blocked until an unnecessary additional approval arrives. — Fix: Restore >= and extend test_approved_release to cover equality.
